requirements.text: Bachelor’s Degree (BS) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field and a minimum 4 years of prior relevant experience.
Onboarding is contingent upon clearance received/approved.
4+ years’ experience interpretting and applying system and software requirements to structured data or metadata solutions
4+ years’ experience developing or managing structured data, metadata, configuration content, or schema-like definitions
4+ years’ experience developing system level that are modular, scalable, reusable, and maintainable across multiple projects
4+ years’ experience working across cross-functional teams, especially Systems and Software Engineering
4+ years’ experience with integration, verification, validation, and troubleshooting
Understanding of UI-related configuration or data-driven workflows
Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail
Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to coordinate effectively across teams
Experience defining data models, metadata structures, configuration frameworks, or schema-driven solutions for software applications
Experience supporting products or workflows where structured data drives UI behavior, output generation, or system functionality
Familiarity with Mission Data File generation, validation, or related data-driven outputs
Experience with software configuration management and CI/CD pipeline support
Familiarity with Jenkins-based workflows and integration with enterprise engineering tools
Experience in environments requiring reusable solutions across multiple product lines or customer programs
Exposure to C++ development environments sufficient to coordinate effectively with software teams, even if not serving in a primary coding role

The selected candidate will also support integration and verification activities to confirm that metadata, UI content, and Mission Data File (MDF) outputs align with requirements and function as intended. Experience working in Agile teams and familiarity with Jira, JSON, software configuration workflows, and Jenkins-based pipelines is beneficial.
